title: stelis amoena
intro: Stelis amoena, commonly known as the Stelis orchid, is a species of orchid plant that belongs to the family Orchidaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and infections. The health benefits of Stelis amoena include its ability to exhibit antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory activities, which can help in soothing wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating pain. The bioactive constituents of Stelis amoena include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects.
